assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 adopted the new Kafka Connect health check endpoint (as described in proposal 89) for its Kafka Connect health checks; the changelog line alone does not state which environments are exposed or what happens to an operator who does nothing.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: evidence-gap: the single changelog line does not identify which deployments or configurations are exposed to the new health check endpoint (e.g. whether it depends on running Kafka Connect workloads or specific Connect API versions), so no reliable exposure predicate can be built; consequence: evidence-gap: the changelog line does not state any operational effect (whether health checks behave differently in a way operators must verify, or whether anything fails)
